personalized_subject: Size-band stock idea for The Shooting Sock Company
personalized_email_body:
Hi The Shooting Sock Company team,

I was looking at your shooting socks and noticed how many colourways each style carries, from Sunflower on The Ambassador to Pollen & Olive on the Byron, each across three UK size bands. You already offer out-of-stock email alerts on product pages, which is a nice touch.

With the winter season and Christmas gifting both close, the colour-and-size mix can move unevenly. I build Shopify automation systems that keep inventory updates, order handling and supplier notifications running smoothly.

One idea: a low-stock rule per variant that alerts your mill or production planner when, say, Large in a popular colour drops below a set level, alongside your customer alerts.

Would supplier-side reorder alerts like that be useful for your sock range?

Best regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
Shopify Automation & Integration Specialist

personalized_email_body:
Hi Wool Blanket Online team,

I came across your Warm for Winter collection and liked that everything is British made and sold by a family business in Yorkshire. Being able to filter the lambswool hats by origin, such as Made in Scotland, is a helpful detail for shoppers.

As the colder months and the holiday season arrive, winter lines tend to sell quickly. I build Shopify automation systems that simplify stock updates, order processing and supplier notifications.

One workflow that could suit you: tag each product with its maker, and when stock falls below a set level, Shopify sends that maker a reorder note automatically and updates inventory when the delivery is logged.

How do you currently keep track of restocking from your different makers?

Best regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
Shopify Automation & Integration Specialist
